name: Fondation H
known: Hiridjee is chief executive of the Axian Group, a pan-African group in telecommunications, energy, real estate and financial services (Billionaires.Africa, 2026;

name: Galeri Petronas
known: No records of its own: owner PETRONAS posts annual and integrated reports for 2014 to 2025, financial reports, and names its eight directors.

name: ILHAM Gallery
known: Gallery director Rahel Joseph describes it as a "privately-funded public art gallery" opened to fill an institutional gap in Kuala Lumpur (Art & Market, Rahel Joseph, "10 Years of ILHAM Gallery", 23 October 2025).
The gallery calls itself privately funded (Art & Market, written by its director).

name: Musée National du Mali
known: Director General: Daouda Keïta (Maliexpress, 21 April 2026).
It covers staff training, conservation and security of the collections, and cultural mediation for young people.
The minister presented it as a response to the crisis, the lack of conservation resources and falling attendance (Maliexpress).

Aga Khan Trust for Culture: museum director Samuel Sidibé signed a collaboration agreement in June 2006 providing a new information technology system and better conservation facilities, with a plan to reorganise the archaeology and textile reserve collections (Wikipedia, English).
In April 2026 Spain launched a project for training, conservation and outreach.

name: Rencontres de Bamako
known: Past artistic directors include Bisi Silva (2015), Bonaventure Soh Bejeng Ndikung (2019) and Lassana Igo Diarra (2024) (Wikipedia, Biennial Foundation).
The 15th edition runs from 26 November 2026 to 26 January 2027 under the theme REFABULATION(S), with Armelle Dakouo as curator (Biennial Foundation, 4 June 2026).

name: MICAS Malta International Contemporary Art Space
known: Phyllis Muscat is executive chairperson.

name: Institute of Contemporary Art Indian Ocean (ICAIO)
known: Founder: Currimjee established the institute in 2015 (Boston College news, Lonely Planet France).

name: Festival Internacional Cervantino
known: The 2025 edition, 10 to 26 October, had 3,458 artists from 31 countries under executive director Romain Greco (Excélsior).

name: Bikini Wax EPS
known: Elephant (2019) names Daniel Aguilar Ruvalcaba as founder: he started it in 2011 at his grandmother's home in Guanajuato and moved it to Mexico City in 2013 when he went to study art.
It describes itself as a "self-organised study centre/experimental exhibition-making (para)site" and is a member of the de Appel Curatorial Programme 2024 to 2026 (de Appel).

name: MUAC
known: Cuauhtemoc Medina was named chief curator in March 2013, succeeding Maria Ines Rodriguez (Arte al Dia, 21 March 2013).

name: Museo Experimental El Eco
known: The curator of the 2025 show credits UNAM's 2004 rescue with preventing the building from becoming a parking lot (Gaceta UNAM).

Pablo Landa Ruiloba, an anthropologist and the museum's director, said in April 2024 that the museum would widen its focus to architecture and design (El Universal, Frida Juárez Bautista, 26 April 2024).

For its 20 years under UNAM the museum showed "Atmósfera total", curated by David Miranda, from 25 September 2025 to February 2026, with 41 original drawings from "Los amantes y la noche", new commissions by Leo Marz and Alberto Odériz and a temporary library, "Goeritz escrito" (Gaceta UNAM).

name: Museo Jumex
known: Founded by collector Eugenio López Alonso.
Chief curator since 2020 is Kit Hammonds (Wikipedia).
López Alonso is the formal heir and chairs the boards of Jumex and the Jumex Foundation (Bloomberg Línea, 2022).

name: Museo Soumaya
known: Founded by Carlos Slim.
Expansión (2013) quotes critics saying Slim buys pieces at auction as a single lot; the museum's director says Slim had national and international advisers.

name: Museo Tamayo
known: Founded by the artist Rufino Tamayo, who bought international contemporary art from the late 1960s and donated it for a museum.

Its page names a board chaired by Alejandra Servitje Labarrere, with Jimena Franco Méndez as director, an International Council and a benefactor group called the Círculo Contemporáneo (stated by the foundation).
Listed under INBAL in its own directory, and backed by the Fundación Olga y Rufino Tamayo, formed in 1989 by the museum's founders.
